completeness_argument: Clearing denominators gives 9a^2+14b^2=9abn. Reducing mod a and b with gcd(a,b)=1 implies a|14 and b|9. Reducing mod9 implies 3|b. Thus a in {1,2,7,14} and b in {3,9} exhaust all positive candidates; test coprimality and integrality exactly.
executable_check:
from fractions import Fraction
from math import gcd
pairs = [(a,b,int(Fraction(a,b)+Fraction(14*b,9*a))) for a in [1,2,7,14] for b in [3,9] if gcd(a,b)==1 and (Fraction(a,b)+Fraction(14*b,9*a)).denominator==1]
assert pairs == [(1,3,5),(2,3,3),(7,3,3),(14,3,5)]
